name: Apple Seed
source:
Parvin has always lived a sheltered life, controlled by her doting if over-protective parents. This puts her at odds with her girlfriend, Roshanak, especially since Roshanak is an independent working girl who's not let her parents or anyone else dictate for her what kind of life she must live. Yet they must learn to put aside their differences if they want to survive the ever-haunting circles of life's eyes themselves.

[From [url=https://ashirah.itch.io/apple-seed]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
帕尔温从小在父母百般溺爱却又过度保护的控制下长大，一直过着温室花朵般的生活。这让她与女友罗莎娜克摩擦不断——毕竟罗莎娜克是个独立自主的职场女性，从不允许父母或任何外人对她的人生指手画脚。然而，倘若两人想要在世俗目光无处不在的审视围困中生存下去，就必须学会放下彼此的分歧。

[摘自[url=https://ashirah.itch.io/apple-seed]itch.io[/url]]
